text: Program description:The basic knowledge of mathematics and mechanics and the basic theory of aircraft engineering and the overall structure design and strength analysis and test capability of the aircraft can be cultivated. It can be engaged in the overall design, structural design and research, structural strength analysis and test of the aircraft (including the spacecraft and carrier), and the design and manufacture of general machinery. Level engineering technicians and researchers.Main subjects:Aeronautics and astronautics science and technology, mechanics, mechanics. Main courses: material mechanics, mechanical design, elastic mechanics, structural mechanics, hydrodynamics and aerodynamics foundation, aircraft dynamics, flight mechanics, mechanical properties and structural strength, test technology, automatic control theory, etc.Direction of employment:After graduation, students can engage in aircraft (including spacecraft and carrier) overall design, structural design and research, structural strength analysis and testing, and are engaged in general mechanical design and manufacturing.
